tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy. Cover title (THAI BINH), sector titles, banner-bar text. 10.7:1 on `mist`, 10:1 on `ice`.

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Cover second line (INVESTMENT TRADING / CORPORATION) and emphasised list items (Core Values). 13:1 on white.

tokens.name: navy-panel
tokens.usage: Solid navy panel behind white text (Connection, Education & Well-being slide); geometric square blocks. White on it 11.4:1.

tokens.name: navy-block
tokens.usage: Square block in the stepped-square motif (closing community slide).

tokens.name: royal
tokens.usage: Section-divider and Thank-you ground (the deep end of the blue photo gradient). White text 8.6:1.

tokens.name: blue-block
tokens.usage: Alternating band in stacked navy panels.

tokens.name: blue-mid
tokens.usage: Lighter alternating band in stacked panels; 5.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Slide title first line, card titles, timeline years. 12.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and timeline captions. 15.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Card lead statements (Vision / Mission text). 8.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Slide title second line (the subtitle under the heading). Exact from the source; 2.25:1 on white — below 3:1 even at 32px. Keep it for ≥32px headline subtitles only; never for body text.

tokens.name: sky-tint
tokens.usage: Subtitle / light accent text on `royal` and `navy-panel` (6.4:1 / 8.5:1).

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Section number (01., 02.) on the divider ground. 3.3:1 on `royal` — display size (≥24px bold) only.

tokens.name: decadas-cyan
tokens.usage: The 3 Décadas anniversary mark colour; decorative rings and hand swooshes. Not for text on white.

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Banner bar fill (OUR SUPPLIERS, THAI BINH'S KEY BRANDS), light panels.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Cover and content-slide pale ground.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Pale pink ground of the ESG slide.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Logo red (the sail swoosh). Reserved for the mark and large accents.

tokens.name: red-headline
tokens.usage: Red headline words (ACCOMPANYING / CONNECTING), 4.8:1 on white.

tokens.name: red-signal
tokens.usage: Tag fills, timeline dots, short title underlines, card underline dots. White text on it 4.4:1 — only at 17px medium or larger (large-ish tags); for smaller labels use `red-headline`.

tokens.name: red-block
tokens.usage: Large red block and the oversized FOR headline; the red swoosh that ends sector slides.

tokens.name: gray
tokens.usage: Neutral secondary text, 7:1 on white.

tokens.name: gray-caption
tokens.usage: Italic source/caption lines (300+ suppliers…), 5:1 on white.

tokens.name: logo-gray
tokens.usage: THAI BINH wordmark grey inside the colour logo. Reference only.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Card fill, text on blue/red grounds.

tokens.name: sector-food
tokens.usage: TBFood orange — swoosh/accent on the Food Products slide only.

tokens.name: sector-agri
tokens.usage: TBAgri green — accent on the Agriculture slide only.

tokens.name: sector-agri-light
tokens.usage: TBAgri light green — secondary agri accent.

tokens.name: sector-comm
tokens.usage: TBComm teal — swoosh on the Communication slide.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Slide ground. Light = content slides; dark = section dividers, cover-back and Thank-you.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Secondary ground / panel.

tokens.name: text-title
tokens.usage: Slide and section titles on `surface`.

tokens.name: text-subtitle
tokens.usage: Second title line on `surface` (light value fails contrast — see `sky`).

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on `surface` and `surface-alt`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and taglines on `surface` (7:1 light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-number
tokens.usage: Section numbers 01.–05.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Dots, underlines, tags.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card fill; card text stays `heading`/`ink` in both themes.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Card statements and bullet lists, `ink-soft` or `navy-deep`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The success of a journey is not measured by the miles traveled.
styles.usage: Paragraph copy, justified in long letters, `ink`.

styles.name: fine-print
styles.usage: Addresses on the Thank-you slide only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its underline.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inner gaps, bullet indents.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Title line step (title → subtitle).

tokens.name: slide-margin
tokens.usage: Left/right slide margin: slide titles and banner bars start at x=81 on the 1440 canvas.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Tags, banner bars, square blocks — the vector shapes in the deck are square.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: White content cards (Vision/Mission, ESG, market overview). Estimated from the rendered slides.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Icon discs, timeline dots, the circular photo frame.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Soft blue drop under white cards on pale grounds (approximation of the deck's raster shadow).
